name: linter
author: lumine-code
description: Linting infrastructure with inline markers and hovers.

lintPreviewTabs.description: Lint tabs while they are still in preview status

lintOnOpen.title: Lint on Open
lintOnOpen.description: Lint files automatically when they are opened

lintOnChange.title: Lint on Change
lintOnChange.description: Lint files while typing, without the need to save (only for supported providers)

lintOnChangeInterval.title: Lint on Change Interval
lintOnChangeInterval.description: Interval at which linting is done as you type (in ms)

showHoverTooltip.title: Show Hover Tooltip
showHoverTooltip.description: Show linter messages in the tooltip of the `hover` package when the pointer rests on an issue or on its gutter dot. Requires that package.

largeFileLineCount.title: Large File Line Count
largeFileLineCount.description: Skip inline decorations for files with more lines than this

longLineLength.title: Long Line Length
longLineLength.description: Skip inline decorations if any line exceeds this length

editorScrollZone.title: Editor scroll zone
editorScrollZone.description: Where the cursor lands after jumping to a message, as a % of viewport height. One value e.g. `25` always scrolls it there. Two are a band it may sit in untouched: `0, 50` moves it to the edge it crossed, `50, 0` throws it to the opposite edge for maximum room ahead. 0 = top margin, 100 = bottom margin.
